chunks: He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji'abi informed me, saying: Ali ibn Ismail narrated to me, saying: Muhammad ibn Khalaf narrated to us, saying: Husayn al-Ashqar narrated to us, saying: Qais narrated to us, from Laith ibn Abi Sulaim, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla, from al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon them both, who said: The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his family, said:

"Adhere to our love, the Ahlul Bayt, for whoever meets Allah while loving us shall enter Paradise through our intercession. By the One in Whose Hand is my soul, a servant does not benefit from his deeds except through his recognition of our truth."

key_terms.حَقّ: haqq — truth, right, the divinely established authority and right of the Ahlul Bayt
key_terms.شَفَاعَة: shafa'ah — intercession, the ability of the Ahlul Bayt to intercede on behalf of their lovers on the Day of Judgment
key_terms.مَعْرِفَة: ma'rifah — recognition, spiritual knowledge and acknowledgment of the truth of the Ahlul Bayt
key_terms.مَوَدَّة: mawaddah — deep love and affection, specifically for the Ahlul Bayt

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about loving the Ahlul Bayt and entering Paradise?
ai.summary: This prophetic tradition, transmitted through Imam al-Husayn (AS), establishes two foundational principles of Shia theology: that love for the Ahlul Bayt is the prerequisite for entering Paradise through their intercession, and that recognition of their divinely-appointed authority (haqq) is essential for one's deeds to be accepted. The Prophet (SAWW) solemnly swore by Allah to emphasize that mere good works without this recognition are insufficient.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 2. He said: Abu Bakr, Muhammad ibn Umaral-Ji’abi reported from ‘Ali. ibn Ismail, who reported from Muhammad ibn Khalaf, who reported from Husayn al-Ashqar, who reported from Qais, from Laith ibn Abi Sulaim, from Abdul Rehman ibn Abu Layla, from al-Husayn ibn ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib who said: The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said:

"Adhere yourselves to our love, the Ahlul Bayt, for surely, whoever meets Allah, having love for us (in his heart) he shall enter Paradise with our intercession. And By Him Who controls my spirit, a servant (of Allah) benefits nothing from his (good) deeds, unless he has recognized our Truth."
